Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action saved_queries, which opens the page with the saved queries: searches over the index by year, tax context, kind, tags and text, with an export of what they find. Also the title of that Hermes page and its sidebar entry.

Theme name of the key action saved_queries, shown dimmed after its plain name action.saved_queries in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name (an inquiry, filed like a form); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Line at the top of the saved queries page explaining what it is for.
strings.en: Searches over your documents. Running one only looks; exporting copies the files it found into a folder you choose and never changes the originals.
strings.de: Suchen über deine Dokumente. Ausführen schaut nur nach; Exportieren kopiert die gefundenen Dateien in einen Ordner deiner Wahl und ändert die Originale nie.

strings.context: Shown on the saved queries page while the list loads.
Shown on the saved queries page when no query is saved yet.
strings.en: No saved queries yet. Fill in the form and save one.
strings.de: Noch keine Abfragen gespeichert. Fülle das Formular aus und speichere eine.

strings.context: Column header of the saved queries list: what the query asks for, in short.
Column header of the saved queries list: how many documents the query found the last time it ran here.
Display name of the document kind 'invoice' as the rules or the AI write it; other kinds are shown as written.
Display name of the document kind 'receipt' as the rules or the AI write it; other kinds are shown as written.
Display name of the document kind 'contract' as the rules or the AI write it; other kinds are shown as written.
Display name of the document kind 'letter' as the rules or the AI write it; other kinds are shown as written.
Display name of the document kind 'quote' as the rules or the AI write it; other kinds are shown as written.
Short form of a query without any criterion in the saved queries list: it finds every document.
Form label on the saved queries page: the year of the document date.
Form label on the saved queries page: tax context.
Form label on the saved queries page: kind of document.
Form label on the saved queries page: tags.
Form label on the saved queries page: words that occur in the text of the document.
Tax context choice on the saved queries page: any context, the query does not ask for one.
Description under the year field of the saved queries page.
strings.en: Year of the document date, for example 2024

strings.context: Description under the kind field of the saved queries page.
strings.en: Upper and lower case do not matter

strings.context: Description under the tags field of the saved queries page.
strings.en: All of them must be on the document, separated by commas
strings.de: Alle müssen am Dokument sein, mit Komma getrennt

strings.context: Description under the full text field of the saved queries page.
strings.en: All words must occur in the text
strings.de: Alle Wörter müssen im Text vorkommen

strings.context: Problem on the saved queries page: the year text is not a year.
strings.en: The year must be a number like 2024.
strings.de: Das Jahr muss eine Zahl wie 2024 sein.

strings.context: Problem on the saved queries page: a query cannot be saved without a name.
strings.en: A saved query needs a name.
strings.de: Eine gespeicherte Abfrage braucht einen Namen.

strings.context: Problem on the saved queries page. Takes the error detail.
Button on the saved queries page: closes it.
Button on the saved queries page: starts an empty, new query.
Button on the saved queries page: saves the form as a query, or the change of the selected one.
Button on the saved queries page: asks whether to delete the selected query.
Button on the saved queries page: runs the query of the form and shows what it finds.
Button on the saved queries page: opens the step that asks where to export the found files. Disabled while there is nothing to copy.
Button on the saved queries page: backs out of the export step.
Question in the saved queries page before a query is deleted. Takes the name of the query.
strings.en: Delete the query ‘{name}’? Documents stay as they are.

strings.context: Button in the delete question of the saved queries page: deletes the query.
Label of a figure under a run of a saved query: how many documents were found.
Button under a run of a saved query: shows the found documents.
Button under a run of a saved query: hides the found documents.
Last line under the list of found documents when there are more than fit. Takes the number left out.
Mark behind a found document whose file is gone.
Heading of the export step on the saved queries page.
Line in the export step: the folder the files are copied into. Takes the path.
Line in the export step: how many files would be copied. Takes the number.
Line in the export step: the CSV file written beside the copies. Takes the file name.
The pattern of the CSV file name shown in the export step; date and time of the export fill the placeholders.
Sentence in the export step: what the export does and does not do.
strings.en: Copies only; moves and deletes nothing. Existing files stay untouched.
strings.de: Kopiert nur, verschiebt und löscht nichts. Vorhandene Dateien bleiben unangetastet.

strings.context: Button in the export step: opens the system dialog to choose the target folder.
Button in the export step: copies the files and writes the CSV.
Footer note on the saved queries page after an export. Takes the numbers and the CSV file name.
strings.en: Copied {copied}, skipped {existing} that exist and {missing} that are missing. CSV: {csv}
strings.de: {copied} kopiert, {existing} vorhandene und {missing} fehlende übersprungen. CSV: {csv}

strings.context: Entry of the command palette that runs the key action settings, which opens the settings as a tab. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Label of the third tab in the title bar while the settings are open. One word, noun.
Colored field at the left end of the status bar while the settings tab is open. Upper case, a single short word.
Text in the status bar while the settings tab is open: tells that a changed setting is already in effect and written to the file.
Right end of the status bar while the settings tab is open: how many settings were changed since the tab was opened. Takes the number.
Placeholder of the search field above the feature list on the settings tab. One word, verb.
Note at the bottom of the feature list on the settings tab. Says that the settings live in the file config.toml and that every change is written there. The file name stays as it is.
strings.en: Everything lives in config.toml. Every change here is written to it.
strings.de: Alles steht in config.toml. Jede Änderung hier schreibt dorthin.

strings.context: Shown on the settings tab when the search matches no feature and no setting.
Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: the look of the program, its color scheme. One word, noun.
Line under the heading of the appearance page on the settings tab: a color field left empty takes the color of the chosen scheme and VS Code theme.
strings.en: How ncrs looks. A color left empty comes from the scheme and the theme.
strings.de: Wie ncrs aussieht. Eine leere Farbe kommt aus dem Schema und dem Theme.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: the language of the interface. One word, noun.
Line under the heading of the language page on the settings tab.
Entry of the feature list on the settings tab for the filing module, next to its theme name Hermes. One word, noun.
Line under the heading of the filing page on the settings tab. Hermes is the name of the filing module.
strings.en: Hermes picks up new documents, reads them and files them by your rules.
strings.de: Hermes holt neue Dokumente ab, liest sie und legt sie nach deinen Regeln ab.

strings.context: Name of a setting on the appearance page: which built-in color scheme the look starts from.
Explanation under the color scheme setting: colors from a VS Code theme or from the theme section of the file are laid over the scheme chosen here.
strings.en: The built-in look. Colors of a VS Code theme or of [theme] come on top.
strings.de: Das eingebaute Aussehen. Farben eines VS-Code-Themes oder aus [theme] kommen darüber.

strings.context: Name of the built-in color scheme Cosmic, the calm dark grey look that earlier versions had without any setting. A proper name; keep it.
Name of the built-in color scheme with the earlier dark teal look. A proper name or a plain color word.
Name of the built-in color scheme Classic, the look of the old two-panel file managers.
Name of the built-in color scheme Dracula. A proper name; keep it.
Name of a setting on the appearance page: the VS Code color theme file laid over the color scheme.
Explanation under the VS Code theme setting: a theme file chosen on disk is laid over the color scheme.
strings.en: A theme file (JSON), laid over the color scheme.
strings.de: Eine Theme-Datei (JSON), über das Farbschema gelegt.

strings.context: Value of the VS Code theme setting when the config names no theme file.
Button next to the VS Code theme setting that opens the card to download a theme. The ellipsis says a card follows.
Name of the setting on the language page: the language of the interface.
Explanation under the language setting: what is chosen here is written to the file, while the quick switch of the function key row only lasts for the session.
strings.en: Written to config.toml. The quick switch lasts for the session only.
strings.de: Wird in die config.toml geschrieben. Der Schnellwechsel gilt nur für diese Sitzung.

strings.context: Label of the switch under the language setting: whether the names from the Futurama show are shown next to the plain names. Short, a row label.

strings.de: Zeigt die Namen aus der Serie neben den Klartext-Namen, z. B. Smell-o-scope neben Suche.

strings.context: Name of the setting on the filing page that switches the filing module Hermes on or off.
Explanation under the setting that switches Hermes on: it works in the background while the program runs.
strings.en: Picks up and files documents while ncrs runs.
strings.de: Holt Dokumente ab und legt sie ab, solange ncrs läuft.

strings.context: Value of a switched on setting on the settings tab, next to its checkbox. One word.
Value of a switched off setting on the settings tab, next to its checkbox. One word.
Fourth choice of the load setting, shown only when the config names a number of workers. Takes the number.
Name of the setting on the filing page for the files that read text from scans and images.
Explanation under the text recognition models: they are downloaded once, after asking.
strings.en: Needed to read scans and images. Downloaded once, after asking.
strings.de: Nötig, um Scans und Bilder zu lesen. Wird einmal geladen, nach Rückfrage.

strings.context: Status of the text recognition models when their folder has files. Lower case, one or two words.
Status of the text recognition models or the AI model when the files are not there. Lower case.
Button next to a model setting that opens the card to download the model. The ellipsis says a card follows.
Name of the setting on the filing page that tells how scans and images are read when the system has its own text recognition (macOS). There is nothing to change.
Status of the text recognition on the filing page where the system reads scans itself. Shown in the success color.

Name of the setting on the filing page that shows the AI model and whether it is there.
Notice in the status bar after a setting was written to the file but only takes effect when the program starts again.

strings.de: In der config.toml gespeichert. Gilt ab dem nächsten Start.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: the programs that view and edit files (F3 and F4). One word, noun.
Line under the heading of the programs page on the settings tab.
strings.en: The programs F3 and F4 open a file with.
strings.de: Die Programme, mit denen F3 und F4 eine Datei öffnen.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: which keys run which command.
Line under the heading of the keyboard shortcuts page on the settings tab.
Name of a setting on the programs page: the program F3 opens a file with to look at it.

strings.de: Leer: das System entscheidet. Wörter mit Leerzeichen in Anführungszeichen.

Explanation under the Open VSX setting: a theme is downloaded by its ID or its link, or from an https link to a VS Code theme file (.json), and then used.
strings.en: Downloads a theme by its ID or link, or from an https link to a theme .json file, and uses it.
strings.de: Lädt ein Theme über seine ID oder seinen Link oder von einem https-Link auf eine Theme-.json-Datei und verwendet es.

strings.context: Shown under the VS Code theme setting when the theme file could not be used in full. Takes the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
Heading of the group of color settings on the appearance page: one row per part of the window.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the background of the whole window.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the background of the two file panels.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the normal text color.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: text that matters less, such as notes and disabled entries.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the names of folders in the panels.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the bar on the current row of a panel.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the text on the cursor bar and in the title bar.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: rows the user marked for a command.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the frame of the active panel.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the title bar of the active panel.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the title bar and frame of the inactive panel.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the bar at the bottom of the window.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the background of dialogs and cards.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the background of menus and the command list.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the color that highlights, such as shortcut letters.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: messages about something that worked.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: error messages.
Shown under a color setting whose text color is hard to read on its background. Takes the name of the background color setting and the contrast ratio, such as 2.1.
Shown under a color setting when the typed value is not a color: it must be a # with six or three hex digits.
Shown under the viewer or editor setting when the typed line has no program in front.
Shown under the viewer or editor setting when the typed line contains a NUL character, which no program can take.
Shown under the viewer or editor setting when the program is a relative path, which would depend on the folder ncrs started in.
strings.en: Use a program name from PATH or an absolute path.
strings.de: Bitte einen Programmnamen aus PATH oder einen absoluten Pfad.

strings.context: Shown under the viewer or editor setting when a quote in the typed line is opened but not closed.
Shown under the viewer or editor setting in the App Store version when the picked file is not an app.
strings.en: Only an app can be chosen here.
strings.de: Hier lässt sich nur eine App wählen.

strings.context: Shown on the settings tab when the path of a picked file has characters the config file cannot hold.
strings.en: The path of this file cannot be saved.
strings.de: Der Pfad dieser Datei lässt sich nicht speichern.

strings.context: Status bar notice in the sandboxed app after a VS Code theme file was picked: the theme includes a second file that could not be copied next to it, so the theme loads without that file's colors. {include} is the included file's name, {reason} says why (the next entry or a system error).
strings.en: The theme includes {include}, which could not be copied ({reason}). It loads without those colours.
strings.de: Das Theme bindet {include} ein, die Datei ließ sich nicht kopieren ({reason}). Es lädt ohne diese Farben.

strings.context: The {reason} of the previous entry when the included file's name points outside the picked theme's folder (.. or an absolute path).
strings.en: it lies outside the theme's folder

strings.context: Shown under the threads setting when the typed value is not a whole number from 1 up.
strings.en: A number from 1 up, or empty.

strings.context: Shown under the endpoint setting when the typed address cannot be used. Takes the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
Shown under the endpoint setting when the address is not on this machine, which is all that is allowed for now.
strings.en: Must be on this machine for now: localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1.
strings.de: Muss vorerst auf diesem Rechner liegen: localhost, 127.0.0.1 oder ::1.

strings.context: Shown under the endpoint or model name setting when it is empty but the own server needs it.
Name of a setting in the AI group of the filing page: how many processor threads the local model may use.
Explanation under the threads setting: an empty field lets Hermes pick the number itself.
Placeholder in the empty threads field: the number is chosen automatically.
Name of a setting in the AI group of the filing page: the web address of the own AI server.
Explanation under the endpoint setting: the address of the server, which must be on this machine for now.
strings.en: An address on this machine, such as http://localhost:11434.
strings.de: Eine Adresse auf diesem Rechner, etwa http://localhost:11434.

strings.context: Name of a setting in the AI group of the filing page: the name of the model on the own server.
Explanation under the model name setting: the name the server knows the model by.
strings.en: The name the server knows the model by.
strings.de: Der Name, unter dem der Server das Modell kennt.

strings.context: Name of the setting on the keyboard shortcuts page: the keys of all commands, changed in a dialog.
Explanation under the keys setting: the dialog lists every command, finds one by name or by its key and records new keys.
strings.en: Find a command by name or key and record new keys.
strings.de: Einen Befehl über Namen oder Taste finden und neue Tasten aufnehmen.

strings.context: Value of the keys setting: how many commands have keys of the user's own. Takes the number.
Value of the keys setting when every command has the keys it ships with.
Button on the keyboard shortcuts page that opens the keyboard shortcuts dialog. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Box at the top of the settings tab when the config file does not load: nothing can be saved until it is fixed. Takes the file path and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
strings.en: The config file {path} cannot be used: {reason}. Nothing is saved until it is fixed.
strings.de: Die Konfigurationsdatei {path} ist nicht verwendbar: {reason}. Bis sie behoben ist, wird nichts gespeichert.

strings.context: Box at the top of the settings tab when the config file has an error at a known line: nothing can be saved until it is fixed. Takes the file path, the line number and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
strings.en: The config file {path} has an error in line {line}: {reason}. Nothing is saved until it is fixed.
strings.de: Die Konfigurationsdatei {path} hat einen Fehler in Zeile {line}: {reason}. Bis sie behoben ist, wird nichts gespeichert.

strings.context: Title of the copy dialog and label of its primary button. Imperative verb, one word.
Title of the move dialog and label of its primary button. Imperative verb, one word.

Dimmed text after the title of the copy and move dialog: how many top-level entries are selected and how large they are. {count} is two or more, {size} is a size like 4.2 GB or an ellipsis while the folders are still being counted.
Same as transfer.summary for exactly one selected entry. {size} is a size or an ellipsis while it is counted.
Label above the number of files in the copy and move dialog when many entries are selected. Plural noun, one word.
Label above the number of folders in the copy and move dialog when many entries are selected. Plural noun, one word.
Label above the total size in the copy and move dialog when many entries are selected. Noun, one word.
Label above the number of entries the size count could not read in the copy and move dialog. Only shown when there are some. Short adjective phrase.
The first names of a large selection, then how many more there are. {names} is a comma separated list of file names, {count} the number left out.
Button in the copy and move dialog that unfolds the list of all selected names. Short verb phrase.
Button in the copy and move dialog that folds the list of selected names away again. Short verb phrase.
Last line of the unfolded name list when it is cut off: how many names are not shown. {count} is the number left out.
Warning in the copy and move dialog: some selected names already exist in the target folder. {count} is two or more.
strings.en: {count} of these names already exist in the target
strings.de: Im Ziel gibt es schon {count} dieser Namen

strings.context: Same as transfer.conflicts for exactly one name that already exists in the target folder.
strings.en: One of these names already exists in the target
strings.de: Im Ziel gibt es schon einen dieser Namen

strings.context: Label of the target folder field in the copy and move dialog, also its placeholder. One word, a preposition.
Label of the choice in the copy and move dialog for what happens when the target already has a name. Reads as the start of a sentence.
Option of the choice for an existing name: ask for each file that is in the way. One word.
Option of the choice for an existing name: replace the file in the target without asking. One word.
Option of the choice for an existing name: leave the file in the target alone and go on. One word.
Hint in the footer of the copy and move dialog: the Tab key switches between the two. Starts with the key name, keep it.
Error under the target field when the typed folder does not exist.
Error under the target field when the typed path is a file, not a folder.
strings.en: The target is not a folder

strings.context: Error under the target field when the target is the folder the selected entries are already in.
strings.en: Source and target are the same folder
strings.de: Quelle und Ziel sind derselbe Ordner

strings.context: Error under the target field when the user wants to move (F6) entries into an archive or a folder inside one. Only copying into an archive works, because a move would delete the originals after rewriting the archive.
strings.en: Files can only be copied into an archive, not moved
strings.de: In ein Archiv lässt sich nur kopieren, nicht verschieben

strings.context: Error under the target field when entries of one archive are to go into another archive, or the target lies inside an archive that is itself inside an archive. Neither is supported; copying out to a folder first works.
strings.en: Archives inside archives are not supported; copy the files out to a folder first
strings.de: Archive in Archiven werden nicht unterstützt; erst in einen Ordner herauskopieren

strings.context: Error under the target field when files on an SFTP server are to be copied into an archive. Copying them to a folder on this computer first works.
strings.en: Files from a server cannot go straight into an archive; copy them to a folder first
strings.de: Dateien von einem Server gehen nicht direkt in ein Archiv; erst in einen Ordner kopieren

strings.context: Error under the target field when the user wants to move (F6) entries out of an archive. Archives are read only, so only copying works.
strings.en: Files can only be copied out of an archive, not moved
strings.de: Aus einem Archiv lässt sich nur kopieren, nicht verschieben

strings.context: Error under the target field when a selected folder would be copied or moved into itself or one of its subfolders.
strings.en: A folder cannot go into itself
strings.de: Ein Ordner kann nicht in sich selbst

strings.context: Error under the target field when the system would not say whether the target folder can be used, for example for lack of permission.
strings.de: Das Ziel lässt sich nicht lesen

strings.context: Dimmed text after the title of the progress dialog of a copy or move: where it goes. {target} is the folder path.
Button of the progress dialog that closes it while the copy or move goes on. Short, like a mode name.
Hint in the footer of the progress dialog: the Escape key stops the job. Starts with the key name, keep it.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_quick_fix: the menu of fixes for the inquiry under the cursor or among the marked files.
First line of the quick-fix menu for one file. {reason} is why Hermes asks, already worded, for example the field that is missing.
First line of the quick-fix menu for several marked files. {count} is their number.
Second line of the quick-fix menu for several files: how many have a suggestion where to file them and how many have none.
Second line of the quick-fix menu for one file: what Hermes read from it. A field it did not find is a question mark. The kind is shown as stored.
Shown in the quick-fix menu while the open inquiries are being looked up. Just an ellipsis, the same in both languages.
Entry of the quick-fix menu for one file: files it where Hermes suggests. The suggested path is shown beside it.
Entry of the quick-fix menu for several files: files all of them whose suggestion lands in one folder. {count} files, {directory} the folder below the archive.
Entry of the quick-fix menu for one file: opens the review page to fill in a missing field.
Entry of the quick-fix menu for several files: those that have no suggestion are filled in on the review page. {count} is their number.
Entry of the quick-fix menu for one file: opens the review page on it to file it by hand and make a rule from it.
Entry of the quick-fix menu that closes it and leaves the inquiry open.
Entry of the quick-fix menu for one file: Hermes leaves it alone from now on.
Entry of the quick-fix menu for several files: Hermes leaves all of them alone from now on. {count} is their number.
First line of the quick-fix menu before a group of files is filed. {count} files, {directory} the folder below the archive.
Second line of the quick-fix menu before a group of files is filed: how it is done.
strings.en: Each is moved on its own, nothing is overwritten.
strings.de: Jedes wird einzeln verschoben, nichts wird überschrieben.

strings.context: Entry of the quick-fix menu that files the group after the summary. {count} is the number of documents.
Entry of the quick-fix menu that returns from the summary to the list of fixes.
Status bar message when the quick-fix key is pressed on a file without an open inquiry.
Status bar message after one document was filed from the quick-fix menu. {path} is the place below the archive.
Status bar message when the quick-fix menu could not file a document because another file is at the suggested place.
strings.en: Not filed: the place is already taken
strings.de: Nicht abgelegt: Der Platz ist schon belegt

strings.context: Status bar message when the document changed or vanished while the quick-fix menu filed it, so Hermes looks at it again.
strings.en: The file changed, Hermes reads it again
strings.de: Die Datei hat sich geändert, Hermes liest sie neu

strings.context: Status bar message after the quick-fix menu filed several documents. Each number is a count; taken means another file is at the suggested place.
strings.en: {filed} filed, {taken} place taken, {requeued} read again, {failed} failed
strings.de: {filed} abgelegt, {taken} Platz belegt, {requeued} neu gelesen, {failed} fehlgeschlagen

strings.context: Status bar message after files were excluded from Hermes by the quick-fix menu. {count} is their number.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Opens the quick-fix menu with Hermes' suggestion for an inquiry.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Opens the move dialog with the inbox as target.
Dimmed note after 'Hand to Hermes' in the Hermes submenu: where the file goes.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Runs the file through the pipeline steps again.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Makes the folder an inbox of Hermes.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Makes the folder the filing location, the archive that documents are filed into.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Makes the folder an archive that Hermes only reads.
Dimmed note after 'Set as archive' in the Hermes submenu: Hermes does not change what is in it.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Hermes leaves the file or folder alone from now on.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Takes back an exclusion.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Opens the Hermes inspection page, at the file's error if it has one.
Status bar message after a file was queued to run through the Hermes steps again. {name} is the file name.
Status bar text while Hermes is rebuilt after the AI setting changed. It stands where the idle line of Hermes stands.
Status bar text while Hermes reads one file again. Takes the file name.
Status bar text while Hermes reads several files again. Takes the file name of the last one asked and the number of the others.
Notice when a file read again got its place from the rules and is filed. Takes the file name.
Notice when a file read again could not be placed and waits for the user in the review list. Takes the file name.
Notice when reading a file again failed. Takes the file name and the reason, which stays as the pipeline worded it.
Notice when a file read again led to the same result as before. Takes the file name.
strings.de: {name}: unverändert, der Inhalt ergibt nichts Neues

strings.context: Notice when a file read again is finished and there is nothing more to say about it, for example after Hermes was rebuilt meanwhile. Takes the file name.
Notice after the button of the review list queued the open reviews to be read again with the AI. Takes the number of documents (more than one).
Notice after the button of the review list queued its single open review to be read again with the AI.
Status bar message when a file cannot be run through the Hermes steps: it is excluded, outside the configured folders, or the pipeline is not running.
strings.en: Hermes cannot process this file now
strings.de: Hermes kann diese Datei jetzt nicht verarbeiten

strings.context: Status bar message after a file or folder was taken back into Hermes' view. {name} is its name.
Status bar message when a file cannot be included because a folder around it is excluded. {folder} is that folder's path.
strings.en: Excluded by the folder {folder}; include that folder instead
strings.de: Vom Ordner {folder} ausgeschlossen; schließe stattdessen den Ordner wieder ein

strings.context: Status bar message when a folder cannot become an inbox because no filing location is set yet; the user sets the filing location first. A whole sentence.
Status bar message when the user starts a Hermes command while the filing module is switched off; the settings page with the switch opens at the same time. A whole sentence.
strings.en: Hermes is off. Switch it on here to sort your documents.
strings.de: Hermes ist aus. Schalte es hier ein, um deine Dokumente zu sortieren.

strings.context: Status bar message when saving a folder's role failed. {reason} is the cause.
Status bar message when a file should go to the inbox but none is configured.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_hand_to_inbox: opens the move dialog for the file under the cursor with the inbox as target.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_process_again: runs the file under the cursor through the Hermes steps again.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_set_inbox: makes the folder under the cursor an inbox.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_set_filing_location: makes the folder under the cursor the filing location.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_set_archive: makes the folder under the cursor a read-only archive.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_exclude: excludes the file or folder under the cursor from Hermes, or includes it again when it is excluded.
strings.en: Exclude from or include in Hermes
strings.de: Von Hermes ausschließen oder wieder einbeziehen

strings.context: Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_inspect: opens the Hermes inspection page for the file under the cursor.
Label of the F2 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key moves the focus to the command line below the panels; at most 8 characters.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action command_line. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Dim label at the right end of the command line while it is empty and does not have the focus, beside the key cap of the key that focuses it.
Right end of the command line while shell commands started from it are still running. {count} is the number of running commands.
Status bar notice when a command typed into the command line ended with an exit status. {command} is the typed line, {code} the exit status number.
Status bar error when a command typed into the command line was ended by a signal and so has no exit status. {command} is the typed line.
Status bar error when the shell for a command typed into the command line could not be started. {command} is the typed line, {reason} the system's explanation.
strings.de: {command}: Die Shell ließ sich nicht starten: {reason}

strings.context: Entry of the command palette that runs the key action key_bindings, which opens the dialog listing every keyboard shortcut. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Name of the key action cursor_up in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel one row up. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action cursor_down in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel one row down. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action page_up in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel one page up. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action page_down in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel one page down. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action first in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel to its first row. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action last in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel to its last row. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action tag_up in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: tags the row under the cursor and moves the cursor one row up. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action tag_down in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: tags the row under the cursor and moves the cursor one row down. As short as a menu entry.
Title of the dialog that lists every keyboard shortcut and lets the user rebind them.
Playful theme name shown dimmed next to the title of the keyboard shortcuts dialog, in the Futurama theme of the app: the switchboard of the Planet Express ship.
Placeholder of the search field of the keyboard shortcuts dialog. Typing searches the action names; pressing a key combination finds the action bound to it.
strings.en: Search by name, or press a key combination
strings.de: Nach Namen suchen oder Tastenkombination drücken

strings.context: Column heading in the keyboard shortcuts dialog over the names of the actions.
Column heading in the keyboard shortcuts dialog over the menu group an action belongs to (File, Edit, View ...).
Column heading in the keyboard shortcuts dialog over the keys bound to each action.
Small tag in a row of the keyboard shortcuts dialog when the action does not have the keys the app ships with. One short word.
Shown dimmed in a row of the keyboard shortcuts dialog when no key is bound to the action.
Shown in the row being rebound in the keyboard shortcuts dialog while the app waits for the new key combination.
Footer note of the keyboard shortcuts dialog while it waits for a new key combination. Esc is the key name.
strings.en: Press the new key combination. Esc cancels.
strings.de: Neue Tastenkombination drücken. Esc bricht ab.

strings.context: Warning in the keyboard shortcuts dialog before a key is taken from another action. {key} is the key combination, {action} the name of the action that has it now.
strings.en: {key} is bound to {action}. Take it from there?

strings.context: Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that takes a key from the action that has it and gives it to the selected one.
Question in the keyboard shortcuts dialog before every action gets the keys the app ships with again.
strings.en: Give every action its built-in keys again?
strings.de: Allen Aktionen wieder ihre eingebauten Tasten geben?

strings.context: Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that gives the selected action the keys the app ships with again.
Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that gives every action the keys the app ships with again. Asks first.
Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that records a further key for the selected action.
Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that removes the focused key of the selected action.
Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that records a new key in place of the focused one.
Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when the pressed key has no name the config file can store, such as F13 or a media key.
strings.en: This key cannot be stored in the config.
strings.de: Diese Taste lässt sich nicht in der Konfiguration speichern.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when a plain letter or digit is pressed: alone it jumps to a file name (type-ahead). Ctrl, Alt and Cmd are key names.
strings.en: Letters and digits need Ctrl, Alt or Cmd: alone they jump to a file name.
strings.de: Buchstaben und Ziffern brauchen Ctrl, Alt oder Cmd: allein springen sie zu einem Dateinamen.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: Escape cannot be bound because it closes dialogs and stops jobs.
strings.en: Esc is reserved: it closes dialogs and stops jobs.
strings.de: Esc ist vergeben: Es schließt Dialoge und stoppt Aufträge.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: the search view handles this key itself, so a search action cannot take it.
strings.en: The search view uses this key itself.
strings.de: Die Suche nutzt diese Taste selbst.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when an action already has the most keys allowed. {count} is that number.
strings.en: An action takes at most {count} keys.

strings.context: Notice in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when the pressed key is already one of the selected action's keys. {key} is the key combination.
strings.en: {key} is already a key of this action.
strings.de: {key} ist schon eine Taste dieser Aktion.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when the change could not be saved to the config file. {reason} is the explanation.
Verb next to the Enter key in the footer hints of the keyboard shortcuts dialog: records a new key for the focused one. One word.
Verb next to the Backspace key in the footer hints of the keyboard shortcuts dialog: removes the focused key. One word.
Verb next to the Shift+Backspace key in the footer hints of the keyboard shortcuts dialog: gives the action its built-in keys again. One word.

Entry of the command palette and the menu bar that runs the key action grant_folder_access, which opens the system folder dialog so the user can allow the App Store version to open another folder or drive. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key. The ellipsis says a dialog follows. Listed only in the App Store version.
Title of the dialog shown at the start of the App Store version while the home folder cannot be opened. The app runs in the macOS App Sandbox and may open only folders the user allows.

Explanation in the dialog that asks the user to allow access to the home folder. macOS lets the App Store version open only the folders the user chooses in a system dialog; one choice of the home folder covers everything below it. Drives and network volumes need a choice of their own.
strings.en: ncrs from the App Store runs in the macOS sandbox and can only open folders you allow. Choose your home folder to browse all of it. A drive or another volume needs its own choice.
strings.de: ncrs aus dem App Store läuft in der macOS-Sandbox und kann nur Ordner öffnen, die du freigibst. Wähle deinen Home-Ordner, um alles darin zu durchsuchen. Ein Laufwerk oder ein anderes Volume braucht eine eigene Freigabe.

strings.context: Second paragraph of the dialog that asks for access to the home folder: the choice is kept, and the command of the command palette adds more folders later. It names the command by its label.
strings.en: Your choice is remembered. Later, "Grant folder access…" in the command list adds more folders.
strings.de: Deine Wahl wird gemerkt. Später fügt „Ordner freigeben…“ in der Befehlsliste weitere Ordner hinzu.

strings.context: Button of the dialog that asks for access to the home folder: closes it without granting anything. The dialog comes back at the next start. One word.
Button of the dialog that asks for access to the home folder: opens the system folder dialog, in the home folder, to choose the folder to allow. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Notice in the status bar when the key action grant_folder_access runs outside the App Store version, which needs no folder grants because it can open every folder.
strings.en: Granting folders is only needed in the App Store version
strings.de: Ordner freigeben braucht nur die App-Store-Fassung

strings.context: Notice in the status bar after the user allowed a folder in the App Store version and the choice was saved. Takes the folder.
Error in the status bar when the access the user allowed to a folder could not be saved, so it would be lost at the next start. Takes the folder and the reason, which stays untranslated.
strings.en: Could not save the access to {folder}: {reason}
strings.de: Der Zugriff auf {folder} konnte nicht gespeichert werden: {reason}

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when the host key a server offers differs from the one recorded earlier for the same host and key type. The login is refused before any password is sent, because this can be an attack. Takes the host, the file that holds the old key and its line number. There is no button to trust the new key.
strings.en: The host key of {host} has changed ({file}, line {line}). Refused: this can be an attack. If the change is expected, remove the old entry.
strings.de: Der Hostschlüssel von {host} hat sich geändert ({file}, Zeile {line}). Abgelehnt: das kann ein Angriff sein. Ist die Änderung erwartet, den alten Eintrag entfernen.

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when the host key of a server is marked as revoked in a known_hosts file. Takes the host.
strings.en: The host key of {host} is marked as revoked
strings.de: Der Hostschlüssel von {host} ist als widerrufen markiert

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when a server offers a host key of another type than the one on record for it in a known_hosts file (an ed25519 key was recorded, and now an ECDSA key comes). strings.de: Der Index wurde entfernt, aber sein Schlüssel ließ sich nicht aus dem Schlüsselspeicher löschen: {reason}

strings.context: Title of the question in the Hermes overview whether to remove the index and begin again.
Body of the question in the Hermes overview whether to remove the index: names what is lost.
strings.en: This removes the index of Hermes with its rules, rule suggestions, saved searches and the undo history. It also removes what it knows about your documents and the entries waiting for review.
strings.de: Damit wird der Index von Hermes entfernt, mit seinen Regeln, Regelvorschlägen, gespeicherten Suchen und dem Rückgängig-Verlauf. Auch sein Wissen über deine Dokumente und die Einträge, die auf Prüfung warten, gehen verloren.

strings.context: Body of the question in the Hermes overview whether to remove the index: says what stays.
strings.en: Your files and folders stay where they are. The key of the index is removed as well. Afterwards you set Hermes up again.
strings.de: Deine Dateien und Ordner bleiben, wo sie sind. Auch der Schlüssel des Index wird entfernt. Danach richtest du Hermes neu ein.

strings.context: Button of the question in the Hermes overview that removes the index. Destructive, red.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence at the top of the overview when Hermes is switched off.
strings.en: Hermes is off. Switch it on and it files your documents.
strings.de: Hermes ist aus. Schalte es ein, dann legt es deine Dokumente ab.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Button next to the sentence that says Hermes is off. Switches the module on.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence at the top of the overview when the user put the setup off.
strings.en: The setup of Hermes is not finished.
strings.de: Die Einrichtung von Hermes ist nicht abgeschlossen.

Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence at the top of the overview when the module failed to start. {reason} is the cause.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Button next to the sentence that says Hermes could not start.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence at the top of the overview when Hermes has no folders yet.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence at the top of the overview when Hermes waits for an answer in one of its cards.
strings.en: Hermes waits for an answer in its own card.
strings.de: Hermes wartet auf eine Antwort in seiner eigenen Karte.

strings.context: Line in the filing setup card or the Hermes setup card when access to the picked folder could not be kept for the next start (macOS sandbox). {path} is the folder, {reason} the cause.
strings.en: Access to {path} could not be kept for the next start: {reason}
strings.de: Der Zugriff auf {path} konnte nicht für den nächsten Start behalten werden: {reason}

strings.context: Label of the row in the Hermes settings page that opens the Hermes overview.
Note under the row that opens the Hermes overview: says what lives there instead of in the settings.
strings.en: Folders, filing pattern, AI, text recognition, load and protection are on the overview of Hermes.
strings.de: Ordner, Ablagemuster, KI, Texterkennung, Last und Schutz stehen in der Übersicht von Hermes.

strings.context: Button next to the row that opens the Hermes overview. One word, verb.
Title of the folded group of technical settings on the Hermes settings page. One word.

First word of the file name that Paste gives a picture or text from the clipboard, followed by date and time and the ending: "Pasted 2026-10-28 08.15.txt". One word, no trailing space, no characters a file name cannot hold.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action paste. It copies files from the clipboard into the active panel, or saves a picture as PNG or text as TXT there; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action copy_files. It puts the tagged files, or the one under the cursor, on the system clipboard as files, so Finder or Explorer can paste them; the key bound to it, if any, is shown beside it.
Status bar notice after Paste when the system clipboard holds no files, no picture and no text, or cannot be read.
strings.en: The clipboard holds no files, image or text.
strings.de: Die Zwischenablage enthält keine Dateien, kein Bild und keinen Text.

strings.context: Status bar confirmation after the user put one file or folder on the system clipboard as a file. Past participle, short.
Status bar confirmation after the user put several files or folders on the system clipboard as files. Takes the count, which is always two or more.

Status bar notice when "Copy files to the clipboard" is used on entries inside an archive or on an SFTP server. Only files on the local disk can go on the system clipboard as files; nothing was copied.
strings.en: Only files on this computer's disk can be copied to the clipboard. Copy them to a folder first.
strings.de: Nur Dateien von der Platte dieses Computers lassen sich in die Zwischenablage kopieren. Kopiere sie zuerst in einen Ordner.

strings.context: Status bar error when the system clipboard refused the files. Takes the reason the system gave.
strings.en: Could not copy the files to the clipboard: {reason}
strings.de: Die Dateien konnten nicht in die Zwischenablage kopiert werden: {reason}

strings.context: Status bar notice when files are dragged out of the window while the selection is inside an archive or on an SFTP server. Only files on the local disk can be dragged out; nothing was dragged.
strings.en: Only files on this computer's disk can be dragged out of ncrs. Copy them to a folder first.
strings.de: Nur Dateien von der Platte dieses Computers lassen sich aus ncrs herausziehen. Kopiere sie zuerst in einen Ordner.

strings.context: Status bar error when the system refused to start dragging files out of the window. Takes the reason the system gave.
strings.en: Could not drag the files out of ncrs: {reason}
strings.de: Die Dateien konnten nicht aus ncrs herausgezogen werden: {reason}

strings.context: Title of the dialog that asks for the file name when a picture or text from the clipboard is pasted into a folder.
Confirm button of the dialog that names the file a pasted picture or text is saved as. Verb.
Status bar notice when Paste is used while a copy or another job is running or a dialog is open. Nothing is pasted; the user can paste again later.
strings.en: Paste again when the running job or dialog is done
strings.de: Erneut einfügen, wenn der laufende Auftrag oder Dialog fertig ist

strings.context: Status bar while entries are being put back from the trash. Same shape as job.delete.
Command that shows the trash in place of a panel, listing what can be put back. Plain name.
Theme name of the key action trash, shown dimmed after its plain name action.trash in the command palette, and matched when typing. Matches the garbage ball of action.delete.theme.
Command that puts back what the latest delete (F8) of this session moved to the trash. Plain name.
Theme name of the key action restore_last_deletion, shown dimmed after its plain name in the command palette, and matched when typing. Plays on action.delete.theme, the garbage ball.
Command that opens the system trash in the Finder (macOS only). Plain name.
strings.en: Open the trash in the Finder

strings.context: Name of the trash view, shown in the title bar tab, above the list and in the drive menu, when the whole system trash can be listed (Windows, Linux). The count of entries is appended in brackets.

Name of the trash view on macOS, which can only list what ncrs moved to the trash itself. Shown in the title bar tab, above the list and in the drive menu. The count of entries is appended in brackets.
Column heading of the trash view: the name of the entry.
Column heading of the trash view: the folder the entry was in before it was deleted.
Column heading of the trash view: when the entry was deleted.
Text of the trash view when the system trash holds nothing.
Text of the trash view on macOS when ncrs has not moved anything to the trash that is still there.
strings.de: In ncrs wurde noch nichts gelöscht.

strings.context: Text of the trash view while the entries are being read.
Text of the trash view when the entries could not be read. Takes {reason}.
strings.en: The trash could not be read: {reason}
strings.de: Der Papierkorb konnte nicht gelesen werden: {reason}

strings.context: Hint line at the bottom of the trash view, naming its keys.
strings.en: Enter: put back · Space: tag · Esc: close
strings.de: Enter: zurücklegen · Leertaste: markieren · Esc: schließen

strings.context: Dim line at the bottom of the trash view on macOS: the list is not the whole trash. Takes {key}, the key that opens the trash in the Finder.
strings.en: Only what ncrs moved to the trash. Open the trash in the Finder ({key}) for the rest.
strings.de: Nur, was ncrs in den Papierkorb gelegt hat. Den Rest zeigt der Papierkorb im Finder ({key}).

strings.context: Same as trash.footer_own_with_key, for when the command has no key.
strings.en: Only what ncrs moved to the trash. Open the trash in the Finder for the rest.
strings.de: Nur, was ncrs in den Papierkorb gelegt hat. Den Rest zeigt der Papierkorb im Finder.

strings.context: Status bar notice after entries were put back from the trash. Takes {count}.
Appended to trash.restored when some entries were left in the trash because the user kept what was in their way. Starts with a space. Takes {skipped}.
Status bar error when an entry could not be put back. Takes {name} and {reason}.
Status bar error, pressable, when an entry cannot be put back because the App Store sandbox has no access to the folder it came from. Takes {name}. The press opens the trash in the Finder.
strings.en: {name} cannot be restored here: ncrs has no access to its folder. Click to open the trash in the Finder
strings.de: {name} kann hier nicht wiederhergestellt werden: ncrs hat keinen Zugriff auf den Ordner. Klicken, um den Papierkorb im Finder zu öffnen

strings.context: Status bar error, pressable, on macOS when an entry could not be put back. Takes {name} and {reason}. The press opens the trash in the Finder.
strings.en: {name} could not be restored, click to open the trash in the Finder: {reason}
strings.de: {name} konnte nicht wiederhergestellt werden, klicken öffnet den Papierkorb im Finder: {reason}

strings.context: Status bar notice after F8 moved entries to the trash. Takes {count} and {key}, the key that puts them back.
strings.en: Moved {count} to the trash. {key} puts it back.
strings.de: {count} in den Papierkorb verschoben. Mit {key} kommt es zurück.

strings.context: Same as trash.moved_with_key, for when the command has no key. Takes {count}.
Status bar notice when the key that restores the last deletion is used and nothing of it is left in the trash.
Status bar error when the Finder could not be asked to show the trash. Takes {reason}.
strings.en: The Finder could not be opened: {reason}
strings.de: Der Finder konnte nicht geöffnet werden: {reason}

strings.context: Title of the group that lists the tax contexts on the Hermes settings page. Two words, noun phrase.
Explanation under the title of the tax contexts group on the Hermes settings page. {tax_context} is the literal filing pattern placeholder and must stay as it is.
strings.en: Which tax context a document belongs to, for example Private or Company A. The short name is what {tax_context} puts into filing paths.
strings.de: Zu welchem Steuerkontext ein Dokument gehört, zum Beispiel Privat oder Firma A. Der Kurzname ist das, was {tax_context} in Ablagepfade schreibt.

strings.context: Description of one tax context row on the Hermes settings page: its short name and an example filing path made with it. Takes {short_name} and {example}.
Button in a tax context row on the Hermes settings page: opens the fields to change its name and short name. The ellipsis says more input follows.
Button in a tax context row on the Hermes settings page: opens the question what happens to its documents before it is deleted. The ellipsis says a question follows.
Label of the last row of the tax contexts group on the Hermes settings page: adds a tax context.
Button in the row that adds a tax context on the Hermes settings page: opens the fields for it. Short, like the other buttons of the page.
Label of the row on the Hermes settings page shown while no tax context exists. Followed by the hint what to do.
Description of the row on the Hermes settings page shown while no tax context exists: tells the user what to do next.
strings.en: Add one, for example Private, so documents can be told apart.
strings.de: Lege einen an, zum Beispiel Privat, damit sich Dokumente unterscheiden lassen.

strings.context: Row of the tax contexts group on the Hermes settings page while the list is read from the index.
Row of the tax contexts group on the Hermes settings page when the Hermes index is not open, so the contexts cannot be read or changed.
strings.en: Tax contexts are kept in the Hermes index, which is not open.
strings.de: Steuerkontexte liegen im Hermes-Index, der nicht geöffnet ist.

strings.context: Label of the row on the Hermes settings page when reading the tax contexts from the index failed. The reason follows below it.
strings.en: Tax contexts could not be read

strings.context: Label of the row with the Save and Cancel buttons on the Hermes settings page while a new tax context is entered.
Label of the row with the Save and Cancel buttons on the Hermes settings page while a tax context is renamed. Takes the current {name}.
Description of the row with the Save and Cancel buttons on the Hermes settings page: nothing is stored before Save.
strings.en: Nothing is saved before you press Save.
strings.de: Nichts wird gespeichert, bevor du auf Speichern drückst.

strings.context: Label of the name field of a tax context on the Hermes settings page.
Description under the name field of a tax context on the Hermes settings page: where the name is shown.
strings.de: Wird in Listen und Auswahlen angezeigt.

strings.context: Label of the short name field of a tax context on the Hermes settings page.
Description under the short name field on the Hermes settings page. {tax_context} is the literal filing pattern placeholder and must stay as it is.
strings.en: Goes into filing paths for {tax_context}. Letters, digits, space, - _ and . only.
strings.de: Kommt für {tax_context} in die Ablagepfade. Nur Buchstaben, Ziffern, Leerzeichen, - _ und .

strings.context: Label of the line on the Hermes settings page that shows an example filing path made with the short name typed so far.
Button on the Hermes settings page that stores the added or renamed tax context.
Button on the Hermes settings page that drops the entered tax context or the delete question without changing anything.
Error under the name field on the Hermes settings page: nothing was entered.
Error under the name field on the Hermes settings page: the name is too long. Takes {max}, the most characters allowed.
strings.en: The name has more than {max} characters.
strings.de: Der Name hat mehr als {max} Zeichen.

strings.context: Error under the name field on the Hermes settings page: the name has an invisible control character, for example from pasting.
strings.en: The name must not contain control characters.
strings.de: Der Name darf keine Steuerzeichen enthalten.

strings.context: Error under the name field on the Hermes settings page: another tax context has this name already.
strings.en: Another tax context already has this name.
strings.de: Ein anderer Steuerkontext hat diesen Namen schon.

strings.context: Error under the short name field on the Hermes settings page: nothing was entered.
Error under the short name field on the Hermes settings page: too long. Takes {max}, the most characters allowed.
strings.en: The short name has more than {max} characters.
strings.de: Der Kurzname hat mehr als {max} Zeichen.

strings.context: Error under the short name field on the Hermes settings page: a character that cannot be part of a path name, such as a slash. Takes {character}.
strings.en: ‘{character}’ is not allowed in a short name. Use letters, digits, space, - _ and . only.
strings.de: ‘{character}’ ist in einem Kurznamen nicht erlaubt. Nur Buchstaben, Ziffern, Leerzeichen, - _ und . sind möglich.

strings.context: Error under the short name field on the Hermes settings page: it starts with a dot, which would make a hidden folder.
strings.en: The short name must not start with a dot.
strings.de: Der Kurzname darf nicht mit einem Punkt beginnen.

strings.context: Error under the short name field on the Hermes settings page: it contains two dots in a row, which a path could use to leave its folder.
strings.en: The short name must not contain two dots in a row.
strings.de: Der Kurzname darf nicht zwei Punkte hintereinander enthalten.

strings.context: Error under the short name field on the Hermes settings page: the word none is kept for documents without a tax context. Keep the quoted none as it is.
strings.en: ‘none’ is kept for documents without a tax context.
strings.de: ‘none’ ist für Dokumente ohne Steuerkontext reserviert.

strings.context: Error under the short name field on the Hermes settings page: another tax context has this short name already.
strings.en: Another tax context already has this short name.
strings.de: Ein anderer Steuerkontext hat diesen Kurznamen schon.

strings.context: Error on the Hermes settings page when saving or deleting a tax context failed for another reason. Takes {reason}.
Label of the first row of the delete question on the Hermes settings page. Takes the {name} of the tax context.
Description in the delete question on the Hermes settings page when no document, rule or saved query uses the tax context.
Description in the delete question on the Hermes settings page when the tax context is in use. Takes the {name} and {uses}, a list such as 12 documents, 2 rules and 1 saved query.
Description in the delete question on the Hermes settings page while it is looked up what uses the tax context.
strings.de: Es wird geprüft, was ihn verwendet …

strings.context: Part of the list of uses in the delete question on the Hermes settings page: exactly one document. Takes {count}. German in the dative after von.
Part of the list of uses in the delete question on the Hermes settings page: several documents. Takes {count}. German in the dative after von.
Part of the list of uses in the delete question on the Hermes settings page: exactly one rule. Takes {count}. German in the dative after von.
Part of the list of uses in the delete question on the Hermes settings page: several rules. Takes {count}. German in the dative after von.
Part of the list of uses in the delete question on the Hermes settings page: exactly one saved query. Takes {count}. German in the dative after von.
Part of the list of uses in the delete question on the Hermes settings page: several saved queries. Takes {count}. German in the dative after von.
Joins two parts of the list of uses in the delete question on the Hermes settings page. Takes {first} and {second}.
Joins three parts of the list of uses in the delete question on the Hermes settings page. Takes {first}, {second} and {third}.
Label of the row on the Hermes settings page where the user picks which tax context the documents, rules and saved queries move to.
Description of the row on the Hermes settings page that picks where the uses of a deleted tax context move to.
strings.en: Documents, rules and saved queries get this tax context instead.
strings.de: Dokumente, Regeln und gespeicherte Abfragen bekommen stattdessen diesen Steuerkontext.

strings.context: Choice on the Hermes settings page in the delete question: the uses get no tax context at all.
Label of the last row of the delete question on the Hermes settings page, beside the Cancel and Delete buttons.
strings.de: Nichts ändert sich, bevor du bestätigst.

strings.context: Button of the delete question on the Hermes settings page: deletes the tax context and moves its uses.
Button in a tax context row on the Hermes settings page: opens the conditions that assign documents to this context.
Label of the condition editor of a tax context on the Hermes settings page. Takes the context name.
Note of the condition editor of a tax context: the order in which a document gets its tax context.
strings.en: A rule that sets a context comes first, a context already set stays. Otherwise the conditions of all contexts decide: if exactly one context fits, the document gets it. If none or several fit, the document goes to the review.
strings.de: Zuerst zählt eine Regel, die einen Kontext setzt, ein schon gesetzter Kontext bleibt. Sonst entscheiden die Bedingungen aller Kontexte: Passt genau ein Kontext, bekommt das Dokument ihn. Passt keiner oder passen mehrere, kommt das Dokument in die Prüfung.

strings.context: Row of the condition editor of a tax context while the stored conditions are read.
Kind of a condition: the document text contains the value.
Kind of a condition: the document text contains the value as a whole word.
Kind of a condition: the document text matches a regular expression.
Kind of a condition: the sender of the document is the value.
Kind of a condition: the address of the sender is the value.
Kind of a condition: the document names this IBAN.
Kind of a condition: the document names this tax number.
Kind of a condition: the address block of the document names this recipient.
Kind of a condition: the document lies in this folder.
Label of one condition in the condition editor, which the rule form and the tax contexts of the Hermes settings share. Takes the position of the condition in the list, starting at 1.
Line of the condition editor when the list has no condition yet.
Label of the choice between any and all conditions in the condition editor. Shown when there are two or more conditions.
Choice in the condition editor: one condition is enough. Continues the label Matches when.
Choice in the condition editor: every condition must hold. Continues the label Matches when.
Button of the condition editor: adds an empty condition to the list.
Button at the end of a condition in the condition editor: removes that condition.
Label of the checkbox at a condition in the condition editor: the condition holds when the text does not match. One word, lowercase.
Error line under a condition in the condition editor when its value is empty and the user tried to save.
Error line under a condition of the kind regular expression whose value cannot be compiled. Takes the reason, which stays in English.
Error line under a condition of the kind IBAN whose value fails the checksum.
strings.en: Not a valid IBAN: the check digits do not match.
strings.de: Keine gültige IBAN: die Prüfziffern stimmen nicht.

strings.context: Review reason in the review list: the conditions of no tax context fit the document.
Review reason in the review list: the conditions of several tax contexts fit the document, so none was chosen.
Line in the review list form: the tax context was assigned by a condition of the context. Takes the kind of the condition and its value.

Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action rules, which opens the page that lists all filing rules as readable sentences. Also the title of that Hermes page and its sidebar entry. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action rules, shown dimmed after its plain name action.rules in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name (Hermes is a bureaucrat, and rules are his regulations); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Paragraph at the top of the rules page: what rules are and in which order they apply.
strings.en: Hermes files a document with the first rule that matches; rules higher up come first.
strings.de: Hermes legt ein Dokument mit der ersten Regel ab, die passt; weiter oben stehende Regeln kommen zuerst.

strings.context: Line under the explanation on the rules page showing how a rule reads. Takes an example rule sentence.

Example rule sentence on the rules page, written the way the page shows every rule: conditions, then an arrow, then kind, tax context, tags and filing pattern. The curly brackets in the pattern are placeholders of the filing pattern and stay as they are.
strings.en: If the sender is “Company A” → Invoice · Company · #tax · {year}/{sender}
strings.de: Wenn der Absender „Company A“ ist → Rechnung · Firma · #steuer · {year}/{sender}

strings.context: Shown on the rules page while the rules are being loaded.
Shown on the rules page when there is no confirmed rule yet.
strings.en: No rules yet. Create one with “New rule”, or let rules come from suggestions and from filing in the review list.
strings.de: Noch keine Regeln. Lege mit „Neue Regel“ eine an, oder lass Regeln aus Vorschlägen und beim Ablegen in der Prüfliste entstehen.

strings.context: Title of the column with the rule sentences in the list on the rules page.
Title of the column on the rules page that says how a rule came to be.
Title of the column on the rules page with the number of documents a rule has filed.
Start of a rule sentence on the rules page. Takes the conditions of the rule, joined, and what the rule does with a matching document after the arrow.
Word between two conditions of a rule sentence when the rule needs all of them. Shown with a space on either side.
Word between two conditions of a rule sentence when the rule needs only one of them. Shown with a space on either side.
Part of a rule sentence: the rule sets that the document has no tax context.
Part of a rule sentence: the rule leaves the tax context open, so the conditions of the tax contexts decide.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for a piece of text. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a piece of text is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for a whole word. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a whole word is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.

Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for the sender name. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the sender name is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for the address of the sender. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the address of the sender is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for a bank account number. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a bank account number is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the text does not contain the IBAN “{value}”
strings.de: der Text die IBAN „{value}“ nicht enthält

strings.en: the text contains the tax ID “{value}”

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a tax identification number is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the text does not contain the tax ID “{value}”
strings.de: der Text die Steuer-ID „{value}“ nicht enthält

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for the recipient name. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the recipient name is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.

Origin of a rule on the rules page: it was made while filing a document in the review list.
