Verb next to the Alt and arrow keys in the footer of the rules page: moves the rule up or down in the order.
Verb next to the Delete key in the footer of the rules page: deletes the rule.
Button of the rules page: leaves the page.
Button of the rules page: moves the selected rule one place up, so it applies earlier.
Button of the rules page: moves the selected rule one place down, so it applies later.
Button of the rules page: asks whether to delete the selected rule.
Button in the delete question of the rules page: keeps the rule.
Button in the delete question of the rules page: deletes the rule.
Question on the rules page before a rule is deleted. Takes the rule sentence.
strings.en: Delete this rule? {rule} Documents stay as they are.
strings.de: Diese Regel löschen? {rule} Dokumente bleiben unverändert.

strings.context: Error line on the rules page when the index could not be read or changed. Takes the technical detail, which stays in English.
strings.en: The rules could not be read or changed: {detail}
strings.de: Die Regeln konnten nicht gelesen oder geändert werden: {detail}

strings.context: Button of the rules page: opens the form for a new rule.
Button of the rules page: opens the form to change the selected rule.
Verb next to the N key in the footer of the rules page: opens the form for a new rule.
Verb next to the Enter key in the footer of the rules page: opens the form to change the selected rule.
Title of the rules page while the form for a new rule is open.
Title of the rules page while the form to change a rule is open.
Title of the rules page while the form of a suggested rule is open, before it is confirmed.
Paragraph at the top of the rule form: what the parts of a rule are, and that nothing is stored before Save.
strings.en: Conditions say which documents the rule is for; the rest says how Hermes files them. Nothing is stored before you save.
strings.de: Die Bedingungen legen fest, für welche Dokumente die Regel gilt; der Rest sagt, wie Hermes sie ablegt. Gespeichert wird erst mit „Speichern“.

strings.context: Button of the rule form: stores the rule.
Button of the rule form: closes the form and drops the changes.
Line in the rule form under the filing pattern: the folder and file name the pattern gives for a sample document. Takes the path.
Heading of the section below the rule form that lists the documents the rule would match, as a live try. One or two words.
One sentence under the heading of the try section in the rule form: what the list shows and that the try changes nothing.
strings.en: Documents this rule would match. Nothing is filed or moved.
strings.de: Dokumente, auf die diese Regel zutreffen würde. Es wird nichts abgelegt oder verschoben.

strings.context: Line in the try section of the rule form while the documents are being looked through.
Line in the try section of the rule form when no document matches the rule.
Error line in the try section of the rule form when the try could not run. Takes the technical detail, which stays English.
Last line of the try section when more documents match than are listed. Takes the number of the others.
Label in front of a document in the try section of the rule form: it is in the inbox and has no open review. One word.
Label in front of a document in the try section of the rule form: it waits in the review list. One word.
Label in front of a document in the try section of the rule form: it lies in an archive folder. One word.
Shows what a document in the archive stays at, in the try section of the rule form: it is not moved. Takes the path, relative to the archive folder. Reads before the arrow.
Shows in the try section of the rule form that other rules match the document too. Takes the places of those rules on the rules page, such as “3, 5”.
Error line in the rule form when the user tried to save a rule without any condition, which would match every document.
strings.en: Add at least one condition, or the rule would match every document.
strings.de: Füge mindestens eine Bedingung hinzu, sonst würde die Regel auf jedes Dokument passen.

strings.context: Error line in the rule form when the filing pattern is empty and the user tried to save.
Error line in the rule form when the filing pattern contains a block in braces that does not exist. Takes the name between the braces.
strings.en: “{block}” is not a block. Use the buttons below.
strings.de: „{block}“ ist kein Baustein. Nimm die Schaltflächen darunter.

strings.context: Button in the review list: plans the open cases again with the current rules and shows what would change, before anything is filed.
Line in the review list while the documents are being planned again with the current rules.
Sentence at the top of the preview step of the review list, which lists documents with where they stand now and where the current rules would put them.
strings.en: With the current rules these documents would be filed. Nothing moves before you confirm.
strings.de: Mit den aktuellen Regeln würden diese Dokumente abgelegt. Es wird nichts verschoben, bevor du bestätigst.

strings.context: Column header in the preview step of the review list: why the document is in review now, or that it is not.
Column header in the preview step of the review list: where the current rules would put the document.
Cell in the preview step of the review list: the document is not in review at the moment.
Cell in the preview step of the review list: the document would stay in review. Takes the reason, for example “No rule matches”.
Cell in the preview step of the review list: no text of the document is stored yet, so the rules cannot judge it.
Line under the list of the preview step of the review list. Takes the number of documents that would be filed and the number of all listed documents.
Line in the preview step of the review list when there is no document to plan again.
strings.de: Kein Dokument, das neu geplant werden könnte.

strings.context: Last line of the list in the preview step of the review list when more documents exist than are shown. Takes the number of the others.
Button in the preview step of the review list: leaves the step, nothing is filed.
Button in the preview step of the review list: files the previewed documents. Takes their number (not one).
Button in the preview step of the review list: files the one previewed document.

Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_reprocess_folder: plans the documents of the folder under the cursor again with the current rules and shows a preview in the review list; nothing is filed before the user confirms.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu; acts on the folder under the cursor. Plans its documents again with the current rules and shows a preview first.
Status bar message when Reprocess folder is used on a folder that does not lie in an inbox location; nothing is done.
strings.en: Only folders in an inbox location can be reprocessed.
strings.de: Nur Ordner in einem Eingangsordner können erneut verarbeitet werden.

strings.context: Status bar message after the user confirmed filing the previewed documents while another job is running: the filing starts when that job is done.
strings.en: The documents are filed when the running job is done.
strings.de: Die Dokumente werden abgelegt, sobald der laufende Auftrag fertig ist.

strings.context: Status bar message after the previewed documents were filed. Takes the numbers filed, left in review, changed since the preview (not moved) and read again.
strings.en: {filed} filed, {reviewed} stayed in review, {changed} changed since the preview, {requeued} read again
strings.de: {filed} abgelegt, {reviewed} in der Rückfrage geblieben, {changed} seit der Vorschau geändert, {requeued} neu gelesen
